semiconductor_relevance: High — the company supplies critical components and integrated solutions for semiconductor process chambers.
summary: Zhejiang Yuanxin Advanced Material Co., Ltd. specializes in providing essential materials and components for semiconductor manufacturing processes, including etching, CVD, PVD, and diffusion equipment. They focus on quartz, ceramics, and silicon-based products, ensuring compliance with OEM standards and offering customized solutions to meet diverse client needs.
capabilities: Manufacturing of quartz and ceramic components for semiconductor equipment
Production of RF and microwave window covers for plasma etching chambers
Development of cover rings with high plasma resistance for wafer protection
Supply of components for 12-inch, 8-inch, and 6-inch semiconductor equipment
technical_expertise: Chemical cleaning processes for semiconductor components

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Haining City, Zhejiang Province, focusing on domestic substitution in semiconductor materials.
